14.text: The family ceremonials are arranged in a regular cycle, are celebrated

15.text: from season to season throughout the year, and are directly connected with

16.text: the pursuits of material life; therefore those of the reindeer-breeders differ

17.text: from those of the maritime people. In this respect the difference between

18.text: the Reindeer Chukchee and the Asiatic Eskimo is still greater. Some of the

19.text: ceremonials of the Maritime Chukchee bear a resemblance to those of the

20.text: Reindeer people, and show only such changes as result from their diversity

21.text: in material culture. Many of their ceremonials are similar to the religious

22.text: rites of the Asiatic Eskimo. In this respect, as in many others, the customs

23.text: of the Maritime Chukchee occupy a middle ground between those of the

25.text: has its peculiar groups of images and ceremonials, characterized by special
